title: algerian buckwheat bake
description: sweet, crumbly, one-pot algerian dish made with buckwheat, perfect for a wood-fired bake or a quick weeknight meal.
instructions: Preheat your wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the buckwheat groats, honey, dried dates, and almonds.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut oil, vanilla extract, eggs, and all-purpose flour.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with a drizzle of honey and a sprinkle of almonds, if desired.
Optional: top with a dollop of whipped cream or a sprinkle of cinnamon for added flavor and texture.
